Description: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within his range
Caster gets general idea of the race and level of one being. The target must first be located by Presence or Presence True

As Feel I, except caster stores mental pattern of target. This can be used with other spells (both on this list and others). The caster can only have as many patterns stored as the sum of his Memory and Presense temporary stats (not the bonuses). The caster can choose to release a stored pattern at any given time (the GM should require that a character keep track of all the patterns he has stored)

The caster can transfer a copy of any one Mind Stored person to another caster from the Mentalism realm (i.e., both casters now have the person stored). The target of this spell must know the Mind Store spell
As Feel I, except analyzes 3 targets at once (all targets must be within range)
As Feel I, except caster learns race, profession, and level of target
Caster gets direction and distance to any unshielded mind that he has a mental pattern of (from Mind Store)
Caster gets direction to any unshielded mind which he has a mental pattern of (from Mind Store)
Can get presences in one 50'R. The caster can concentrate on one 50'R area each round

As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the target's actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of the target's actions for the round (and when he wants to perform the action). This does not prevent the target from changing his action (with the appropriate penalty for changing his action)
As above, except range is 1 mile per level
As Feel I, except that range is 100' per level
As Feel I, except analyzes 5 targets at once (all targets must be within range)
As Feel I, except caster may "feel" one target per round
As Mind Typing, except range is 100' per level
As Finding I, except range is 1 mile per level
As Feel I, except analyzes 10 targets at once (all targets must be within range)
As Awareness, except that caster learns all actions of the target
As Finding I, except range is 5 miles per level
As Direction I, except no range limitations
